data.one_liner: A fully customizable emoji feedback widget for user ratings and mood evaluation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to collect user feedback and ratings using customizable static or animated emojis. Supports custom presets, labels, animations, and haptic feedback.
use_when: You need a user feedback or rating form using emojis.
You want support for animated Lottie emojis or custom SVG emoji presets.
avoid_when: You need a standard star-based or numeric rating system.
You require complex form validation integrated with form builders.
strengths: Supports both static SVG and animated Lottie emoji presets.
Highly customizable including scaling, animations, custom labels, and haptic feedback.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to emoji-based rating inputs.
